design.eternalrealm.meadowlark_blade.lor.ja: ヒバリの鳴く丘で鍛えられた、旅立ちの一振り。
design.eternalrealm.meadowlark_blade.lor.en: Forged on the hills where the larks sing: a first sword for the road.

design.eternalrealm.wayfarers_oath.lore.ja: 刃の根元に、いつか帰る場所の名が刻まれている。
design.eternalrealm.wayfarers_oath.lore.en: The name of a home to return to is engraved at its root.

design.eternalrealm.galewild_saber.lore.ja: 草原を呑む影が遺した、嵐を孕む曲刃。
design.eternalrealm.galewild_saber.lore.en: Left behind by the shadow that swallowed the meadow; a curved blade heavy with storm.

design.eternalrealm.pasture_cleaver.lore.ja: 盗賊の頭が牧場から奪った大鉈。肉も骨もまとめて断つ。
design.eternalrealm.pasture_cleaver.lore.en: A bandit chief took it from a farm; it cuts meat and bone alike.

design.eternalrealm.hillwarden_greatswor.ja: 丘の見張り番が代々受け継いできた、地に根を張るような重さ。
design.eternalrealm.hillwarden_greatswor.en: Handed down by the hill wardens; its weight feels rooted in the earth.

design.eternalrealm.garms_maw.lore.ja: 街道荒らしの牙を思わせる刃。斬られた傷はなかなか塞がらない。
design.eternalrealm.garms_maw.lore.en: Its edge recalls the highway scourge's fangs; its wounds are slow to close.

design.eternalrealm.undercity_kris.lore.ja: 水路の闇で密かに研がれた、うねる刃。
design.eternalrealm.undercity_kris.lore.en: Sharpened in secret in the dark of the canals; a blade that winds like water.

design.eternalrealm.thistle_fangs.lore.ja: 棘のある刃先に、草原の毒が染みこんでいる。
design.eternalrealm.thistle_fangs.lore.en: Meadow poison has soaked into their thorned tips.

design.eternalrealm.hooks_reapers.lore.ja: 赤目のフックが獲物を引き寄せた、鉤刃の一対。
design.eternalrealm.hooks_reapers.lore.en: The hooked pair Red-Eyed Hook used to drag his prey in.

design.eternalrealm.herdsman_pike.lore.ja: 狼から群れを守るための、素朴で丈夫な槍。
design.eternalrealm.herdsman_pike.lore.en: Plain and sturdy, made to keep wolves from the flock.

design.eternalrealm.canal_partisan.lore.ja: 沈んだ都の水門番が携えた、幅広の穂先。
design.eternalrealm.canal_partisan.lore.en: The broad head carried by the sluice keepers of the drowned city.

design.eternalrealm.durns_tuskspear.lore.ja: 大猪ドルンの牙を穂の両脇に据えた猪槍。突進を受け止め、押し返す。
design.eternalrealm.durns_tuskspear.lore.en: A boar spear with Durn's tusks set on either side of the head; it stops a charge and drives it back.

design.eternalrealm.sprout_wand.lore.ja: 今も少しずつ伸び続けている、生きた枝の杖。
design.eternalrealm.sprout_wand.lore.en: A living branch that is still growing, a little every day.

design.eternalrealm.lantern_of_the_lost..ja: 地下都市で迷った者を、何度も地上へ導いた灯り。
design.eternalrealm.lantern_of_the_lost..en: A light that has led many who were lost in the undercity back to the surface.

design.eternalrealm.dandelion_staff.lore.ja: 振るうたびに綿毛が舞い、大地の力が宿る。
design.eternalrealm.dandelion_staff.lore.en: Fluff drifts with every swing, carrying the strength of the earth.

design.eternalrealm.shepherds_bow.lore.ja: 見張り台で使い込まれた、誰の手にも馴染む弓。
design.eternalrealm.shepherds_bow.lore.en: Worn smooth on the watchtower; it fits any hand.

design.eternalrealm.rogues_recurve.lore.ja: 地下で毒矢を放つための、反りの強い弓。
design.eternalrealm.rogues_recurve.lore.en: A strongly curved bow for loosing poisoned arrows underground.

design.eternalrealm.skylark_longbow.lore.ja: 放たれた矢は、空へ駆け上がる雲雀のように鳴く。
design.eternalrealm.skylark_longbow.lore.en: Its arrows sing like a lark climbing into the sky.

design.eternalrealm.moonleaf_blade.lore.ja: 月光を浴びた葉の形に打たれた、銀の刃。
design.eternalrealm.moonleaf_blade.lore.en: A silver blade forged in the shape of a moonlit leaf.

design.eternalrealm.heartwood_edge.lore.ja: 古代樹の芯から削り出された、鋼より硬い木の刃。
design.eternalrealm.heartwood_edge.lore.en: Carved from the heart of the ancient tree; harder than steel.

design.eternalrealm.eclipse_moonblade.lo.ja: 月蝕の巨樹が落とした影の刃。闇の中でこそ冴える。
design.eternalrealm.eclipse_moonblade.lo.en: A blade of the shadow the eclipse tree casts; keenest in the dark.

design.eternalrealm.thornwall_greatsword.ja: 茨の垣根のように、刃一面に毒の棘が走る。
design.eternalrealm.thornwall_greatsword.en: Poison thorns run along the whole blade like a bramble hedge.

design.eternalrealm.rootbreaker.lore.ja: 迷宮を塞いだ大根を叩き割った、岩の刃。
design.eternalrealm.rootbreaker.lore.en: A blade of stone that split the great roots barring the maze.

design.eternalrealm.nightbough_claymore..ja: 夜の森の枝が絡み合ったような柄を持つ。
design.eternalrealm.nightbough_claymore..en: Its hilt looks like branches of the night woods twined together.

design.eternalrealm.silkcutter_pair.lore.ja: 蜘蛛の糸さえ音もなく断つ、薄く鋭い一対。
design.eternalrealm.silkcutter_pair.lore.en: Thin and keen enough to part spider silk without a sound.

design.eternalrealm.moth_wing_daggers.lo.ja: 鱗粉をまとった刃。斬られた者は毒に痺れる。
design.eternalrealm.moth_wing_daggers.lo.en: Blades dusted with scales; those they cut go numb with poison.

design.eternalrealm.lunars_moonclaws.lor.ja: 白銀の狼王の爪を研いだ一対。月の夜には冷たく光る。
design.eternalrealm.lunars_moonclaws.lor.en: A pair honed from the silver wolf king's claws; they shine cold on moonlit nights.

design.eternalrealm.vinewhip_spear.lore.ja: 穂先が蔓のようにしなり、毒の樹液を滴らせる。
design.eternalrealm.vinewhip_spear.lore.en: Its head bends like a vine and drips poisonous sap.

design.eternalrealm.owl_feather_lance.lo.ja: 夜の梟のように、音もなく敵へ届く。
design.eternalrealm.owl_feather_lance.lo.en: It reaches the foe as silently as an owl at night.

design.eternalrealm.grovewarden_glaive.l.ja: 森の番人が倒木を払い、道を拓いてきた刃。
design.eternalrealm.grovewarden_glaive.l.en: The blade the grove wardens used to clear fallen trees from the path.

design.eternalrealm.mosslight_staff.lore.ja: 森の魔女が夜道を照らす、光る苔の杖。
design.eternalrealm.mosslight_staff.lore.en: The glowing-moss staff forest witches light their paths with.

design.eternalrealm.crescent_druid_staff.ja: 月の満ち欠けとともに、冷たい力が満ちては引く。
design.eternalrealm.crescent_druid_staff.en: Its cold power waxes and wanes with the moon.

design.eternalrealm.nebulas_starbranch.l.ja: 月影の古老が、星の光を集めて編んだ枝。
design.eternalrealm.nebulas_starbranch.l.en: A branch the Elder of the Moonshade wove from gathered starlight.

design.eternalrealm.willow_shortbow.lore.ja: しなやかな柳の若枝から作られた、軽い弓。
design.eternalrealm.willow_shortbow.lore.en: A light bow made from a supple young willow.

design.eternalrealm.silverbark_bow.lore.ja: 月光で銀に変わった樹皮を、そのまま弓にした。
design.eternalrealm.silverbark_bow.lore.en: Made from bark the moonlight turned to silver.

design.eternalrealm.belladonnas_nightsha.ja: 宵闇の魔女の毒が、弦の一筋一筋に染みている。
design.eternalrealm.belladonnas_nightsha.en: The dusk witch's poison has soaked into every strand of its string.

design.eternalrealm.ore_vein_sword.lore.ja: 掘り出したばかりの鉱脈が、刃の中で琥珀色に光る。
design.eternalrealm.ore_vein_sword.lore.en: A freshly mined vein glows amber inside the blade.

design.eternalrealm.sunscarab_khopesh.lo.ja: 砂塵の神殿で太陽を讃えた、湾曲した聖剣。
design.eternalrealm.sunscarab_khopesh.lo.en: A curved holy blade that once praised the sun in the temple of sand.

design.eternalrealm.vein_eaters_jointbla.ja: 大ムカデの甲殻を節ごとに繋いだ剣。脚の棘に毒が残っている。
design.eternalrealm.vein_eaters_jointbla.en: A sword of the great centipede's shell, joined plate by plate; poison lingers on its leg spurs.

design.eternalrealm.pickaxe_breaker.lore.ja: 坑夫の鶴嘴を打ち直した、無骨な大剣。
design.eternalrealm.pickaxe_breaker.lore.en: A rough greatsword reforged from a miner's pickaxe.

design.eternalrealm.coalheart_greatsword.ja: 芯に埋めた石炭が、斬るたびに赤く燃え上がる。
design.eternalrealm.coalheart_greatsword.en: The coal at its core flares red with every cut.

design.eternalrealm.colossal_ironvein.lo.ja: 坑底の破壊獣の背骨から削り出された、巨大な鉄塊。
design.eternalrealm.colossal_ironvein.lo.en: A colossal slab of iron carved from the spine of the beast of the mine.

design.eternalrealm.ember_shivs.lore.ja: 焚き火の熾火から生まれたような、熱い一対。
design.eternalrealm.ember_shivs.lore.en: A hot pair that seems born from the embers of a campfire.

design.eternalrealm.tombsand_fangs.lore.ja: 神殿の墓所に眠っていた、毒を秘めた曲刃。
design.eternalrealm.tombsand_fangs.lore.en: Curved blades with hidden poison that slept in the temple's tombs.

design.eternalrealm.cogwheel_daggers.lor.ja: 坑道の機械から外した歯車を、刃に仕立てた。
design.eternalrealm.cogwheel_daggers.lor.en: Gears taken from the mine machines and made into blades.

design.eternalrealm.minecart_pike.lore.ja: 線路の鉄を叩き延ばした、まっすぐな長槍。
design.eternalrealm.minecart_pike.lore.en: A straight long pike hammered from rail iron.

design.eternalrealm.veined_steel_lance.l.ja: 青い筋の走る鋼は、坑道の奥でしか採れない。
design.eternalrealm.veined_steel_lance.l.en: Steel with blue veins is found only deep in the shafts.

design.eternalrealm.dolgas_tomb_halberd..ja: 坑道の墓守が、眠りを乱す者を退けてきた斧槍。
design.eternalrealm.dolgas_tomb_halberd..en: The halberd the shaft warden used to drive off those who disturb the dead.

design.eternalrealm.geode_staff.lore.ja: 割った晶洞の奥から、大地の結晶が覗いている。
design.eternalrealm.geode_staff.lore.en: Earth crystals peek out of a split geode.

design.eternalrealm.sunpriest_sceptre.lo.ja: 砂塵の神殿の神官が、日輪へ祈りを捧げた笏。
design.eternalrealm.sunpriest_sceptre.lo.en: The sceptre the temple priests raised in prayer to the sun.

design.eternalrealm.golem_core_rod.lore.ja: 止まったゴーレムの核を籠に収めた。まだ雷が脈打つ。
design.eternalrealm.golem_core_rod.lore.en: The caged core of a stilled golem; lightning still pulses inside.

design.eternalrealm.cave_wren_bow.lore.ja: 狭い坑道でも引ける、小ぶりな弓。
design.eternalrealm.cave_wren_bow.lore.en: Small enough to draw in the narrowest shaft.

design.eternalrealm.firedamp_longbow.lor.ja: 坑道に溜まる燃える気を、矢にまとわせる。
design.eternalrealm.firedamp_longbow.lor.en: It wraps its arrows in the burning gas that gathers in mines.

design.eternalrealm.rustbones_rattle.lor.ja: 錆骨の射手の骨が、弦を引くたびにかたかたと鳴る。
design.eternalrealm.rustbones_rattle.lor.en: The rusted archer's bones rattle each time the string is drawn.

design.eternalrealm.rivermist_sword.lore.ja: 朝の川霧が刃に凍りつき、冷気をまとい続ける。
design.eternalrealm.rivermist_sword.lore.en: Morning river mist froze onto the blade and never left.

design.eternalrealm.pearlguard_blade.lor.ja: 聖なる滝の真珠で飾られた、巡礼者の護り刀。
design.eternalrealm.pearlguard_blade.lor.en: A pilgrim's guard blade adorned with pearls of the sacred falls.

design.eternalrealm.frostcastle_rapier.l.ja: 氷結の城の騎士が、女王への忠誠とともに佩いた細剣。
design.eternalrealm.frostcastle_rapier.l.en: The knights of the ice castle wore it with their oath to the queen.

design.eternalrealm.cascade_greatsword.l.ja: 流れ落ちる滝のように、刃が段を成している。
design.eternalrealm.cascade_greatsword.l.en: Its blade steps down like a falling cascade.

design.eternalrealm.jailers_verdict.lore.ja: 凍てつく地下牢で、看守が罪人に下した刃。
design.eternalrealm.jailers_verdict.lore.en: The blade the jailer brought down on prisoners in the frozen dungeon.

design.eternalrealm.gouras_avalanche.lor.ja: 滝壺の暴君は、この剣と咆哮で雪崩を呼んだ。
design.eternalrealm.gouras_avalanche.lor.en: The tyrant of the falls called avalanches with this blade and a roar.

design.eternalrealm.icicle_pair.lore.ja: 凍えた亡者が握りしめていた、溶けない氷柱。
design.eternalrealm.icicle_pair.lore.en: Icicles that never melt, clutched by the frozen dead.

design.eternalrealm.spirit_tear_daggers..ja: 滝の精が流した涙が、刃となって固まった。
design.eternalrealm.spirit_tear_daggers..en: The tears of the falls' spirit hardened into blades.

design.eternalrealm.mistweavers_fangs.lo.ja: 霧糸の大蜘蛛の牙。傷口から毒が霧のように広がる。
design.eternalrealm.mistweavers_fangs.lo.en: Fangs of the great mist spider; poison spreads from its wounds like fog.

design.eternalrealm.whitewater_spear.lor.ja: 急流を渡る渡し守が、竿の代わりに使った槍。
design.eternalrealm.whitewater_spear.lor.en: A ferryman's spear, used as a pole to cross the rapids.

design.eternalrealm.pilgrim_glaive.lore.ja: 聖なる滝を目指す巡礼者が、獣除けに携えた。
design.eternalrealm.pilgrim_glaive.lore.en: Carried by pilgrims to the sacred falls to keep beasts away.

design.eternalrealm.falls_sovereign_trid.ja: 堕ちた滝守が握っていた、水と氷を統べる三叉。
design.eternalrealm.falls_sovereign_trid.en: Held by the fallen keeper of the falls; it rules water and ice.

design.eternalrealm.holy_dew_staff.lore.ja: 朝露を集めた珠が、清らかな光を放つ。
design.eternalrealm.holy_dew_staff.lore.en: A sphere of gathered morning dew shines with pure light.

design.eternalrealm.handmaidens_snowbell.ja: 女王の侍女が、凍える城で鳴らした澄んだ鈴。
design.eternalrealm.handmaidens_snowbell.en: The clear bell the queen's handmaidens rang in the frozen castle.

design.eternalrealm.ords_shellstaff.lore.ja: 滝守の大亀の甲羅を戴く杖。幾百年の苔が、大地の力を蓄えている。
design.eternalrealm.ords_shellstaff.lore.en: A staff crowned with the falls tortoise's shell; centuries of moss hold the strength of the earth.

design.eternalrealm.heron_bow.lore.ja: 雪原に佇む白鷺のような、白く細い弓。
design.eternalrealm.heron_bow.lore.en: White and slender, like a heron standing in the snow.

design.eternalrealm.frozen_chain_bow.lor.ja: 地下牢の鎖を凍らせて巻きつけた、冷たい弓。
design.eternalrealm.frozen_chain_bow.lor.en: A cold bow wrapped with the frozen chains of the dungeon.

design.eternalrealm.rainbow_spray_bow.lo.ja: 滝の飛沫にかかる虹を、弦に張ったと伝わる。
design.eternalrealm.rainbow_spray_bow.lo.en: Said to be strung with the rainbow that hangs in the falls' spray.

design.eternalrealm.cinder_rune_sword.lo.ja: 刃に刻まれた古い文字が、熾火のように明滅する。
design.eternalrealm.cinder_rune_sword.lo.en: Old letters carved in the blade flicker like embers.

design.eternalrealm.magma_vein_falchion..ja: 火山洞窟の溶岩脈から鍛えた、肉厚の片刃。
design.eternalrealm.magma_vein_falchion..en: A heavy single-edged blade forged from a magma vein of the volcano cave.

design.eternalrealm.agnis_idol_blade.lor.ja: 遺跡の神像が胸に抱いていた儀式の剣。刻まれた炎の文字は今も消えない。
design.eternalrealm.agnis_idol_blade.lor.en: The ceremonial sword the ruin idol held to its chest; the fire letters carved in it still burn.

design.eternalrealm.ruin_guardian_slab.l.ja: 遺跡を守る竜人が振るう、石板そのものの大剣。
design.eternalrealm.ruin_guardian_slab.l.en: Wielded by the dragonkin guarding the ruins: a greatsword that is a stone tablet.

design.eternalrealm.amber_sun_greatsword.ja: 琥珀に封じた陽の光が、刃の奥で揺れている。
design.eternalrealm.amber_sun_greatsword.en: Sunlight sealed in amber sways deep inside the blade.

design.eternalrealm.ashen_dragonfang.lor.ja: 遺跡を焦がす焔の主が遺した、燃え尽きない牙。
design.eternalrealm.ashen_dragonfang.lor.en: The unburnable fang left by the flame that scorched the ruins.

design.eternalrealm.ember_moth_blades.lo.ja: 火口を舞う蛾の翅のように、軽くて熱い。
design.eternalrealm.ember_moth_blades.lo.en: Light and hot like the wings of moths dancing over the crater.

design.eternalrealm.salamander_tongues.l.ja: 炎に棲む蜥蜴の舌のように、刃がちらつく。
design.eternalrealm.salamander_tongues.l.en: The blades flicker like the tongues of lizards that live in fire.

design.eternalrealm.glyphcut_daggers.lor.ja: 遺跡の碑文を彫った刀子。文字が淡く光る。
design.eternalrealm.glyphcut_daggers.lor.en: Knives that carved the ruins' inscriptions; the letters glow faintly.

design.eternalrealm.scorchpoint_spear.lo.ja: 穂先はいつも焼けており、触れたものを焦がす。
design.eternalrealm.scorchpoint_spear.lo.en: Its point is always hot and scorches whatever it touches.

design.eternalrealm.guardian_plate_halbe.ja: 遺跡の守護者の装甲板を、斧刃に仕立てた。
design.eternalrealm.guardian_plate_halbe.en: The axe blade was made from a ruin guardian's armor plate.

design.eternalrealm.valkas_berserk_lance.ja: 遺跡の狂戦士が、血に酔いながら振るった大槍。
design.eternalrealm.valkas_berserk_lance.en: The great lance the ruins' berserker swung, drunk on blood.

design.eternalrealm.kiln_staff.lore.ja: 火口の小鬼が、窯の火を籠に閉じこめて持ち歩く。
design.eternalrealm.kiln_staff.lore.en: The crater imps carry kiln fire caged in it.

design.eternalrealm.lava_oracle_staff.lo.ja: 火山の巫女は、黒曜の髑髏に大地の声を聞いた。
design.eternalrealm.lava_oracle_staff.lo.en: The volcano oracle heard the earth's voice in its obsidian skull.

design.eternalrealm.scorch_eyes_gaze.lor.ja: 灼眼のブレイズの瞳を嵌めた杖。見つめた先が燃え上がる。
design.eternalrealm.scorch_eyes_gaze.lor.en: Set with the scorching blaze's eye; what it stares at bursts into flame.

design.eternalrealm.sunstone_bow.lore.ja: 日の光を蓄える石で補強された、温かい弓。
design.eternalrealm.sunstone_bow.lore.en: A warm bow reinforced with stone that stores sunlight.

design.eternalrealm.flamewing_bow.lore.ja: 竜の翼の骨を思わせる、燃える棘の弓。
design.eternalrealm.flamewing_bow.lore.en: A bow of burning spines that recalls a dragon's wing bones.

design.eternalrealm.rune_tablet_longbow..ja: 遺跡の石版を薄く削った弓身。文字が雷を帯びる。
design.eternalrealm.rune_tablet_longbow..en: Ruin tablets shaved thin into a bow; the letters carry lightning.

design.eternalrealm.cloudcutter.lore.ja: 振るえば雲が二つに割れる、と天空の民は言う。
design.eternalrealm.cloudcutter.lore.en: The sky folk say clouds split in two when it is swung.

design.eternalrealm.skyforge_saber.lore.ja: 天空の古代遺跡の炉で打たれた、雷を帯びる曲刃。
design.eternalrealm.skyforge_saber.lore.en: A curved blade carrying lightning, forged in the furnace of the sky ruins.

design.eternalrealm.alvins_oathblade.lor.ja: 天翔の聖騎士が、空の守りを誓った白銀の剣。
design.eternalrealm.alvins_oathblade.lor.en: The silver sword on which the soaring paladin swore to guard the sky.

design.eternalrealm.glacier_crest_claymo.ja: 万年雪の峰から切り出した、澄んだ氷の大剣。
design.eternalrealm.glacier_crest_claymo.en: A greatsword of clear ice cut from the peaks of everlasting snow.

design.eternalrealm.thunderhorn_greatswo.ja: 雷をまとう獣の角を鍔にした、天空の騎士の大剣。
design.eternalrealm.thunderhorn_greatswo.en: A sky knight's greatsword with a lightning beast's horns for a guard.

design.eternalrealm.thunderhead_greatbla.ja: 峰を砕く巨像の胸から取り出された、雷雲を封じた刃。
design.eternalrealm.thunderhead_greatbla.en: Taken from the chest of the colossus that breaks the peaks; it holds a thundercloud.

design.eternalrealm.wyvern_talon_pair.lo.ja: 飛竜の爪を研いだ一対。裂いた傷から血が止まらない。
design.eternalrealm.wyvern_talon_pair.lo.en: A pair of honed wyvern talons; the wounds they open keep bleeding.

design.eternalrealm.sky_ruin_shards.lore.ja: 遺跡の聖なる結晶を割って作った、光る短剣。
design.eternalrealm.sky_ruin_shards.lore.en: Glowing daggers split from the ruins' holy crystal.

design.eternalrealm.zephyrs_thunderplume.ja: 雷翼のゼファーの風切羽が、そのまま刃になった。振るうたびに稲光が走る。
design.eternalrealm.zephyrs_thunderplume.en: Zephyr the Thunderwing's flight feathers, turned to blades; lightning runs with every swing.

design.eternalrealm.summit_spear.lore.ja: 山頂に、旗の代わりに立てられていた長い槍。
design.eternalrealm.summit_spear.lore.en: A long spear once planted on the summit instead of a flag.

design.eternalrealm.celestial_pillar_gla.ja: 天を支える柱の欠片を、三日月の刃に削り出した。
design.eternalrealm.celestial_pillar_gla.en: A shard of the pillar that holds up the sky, cut into a crescent blade.

design.eternalrealm.lightning_rod_lance..ja: 雷を呼びこむために作られた、銅の槍。
design.eternalrealm.lightning_rod_lance..en: A copper lance made to draw lightning down.

design.eternalrealm.stormcaller_staff.lo.ja: 二股の先端の間で、いつも小さな雷が鳴っている。
design.eternalrealm.stormcaller_staff.lo.en: Small thunder always rumbles between its forked tips.

design.eternalrealm.cirrus_rod.lore.ja: 高空の薄雲のように冷たく軽い、輪の杖。
design.eternalrealm.cirrus_rod.lore.en: A ring staff, cold and light as the thin clouds of the high sky.

design.eternalrealm.starwell_staff.lore.ja: 遺跡の星見の井戸から汲み上げた光を宿す。
design.eternalrealm.starwell_staff.lore.en: It holds light drawn from the ruins' star-gazing well.

design.eternalrealm.windrider_bow.lore.ja: 風に乗る天空の民の、軽く白い弓。
design.eternalrealm.windrider_bow.lore.en: The light white bow of the sky folk who ride the wind.

design.eternalrealm.tempest_recurve.lore.ja: 嵐の中でこそ真価を発揮する、雷を帯びた弓。
design.eternalrealm.tempest_recurve.lore.en: A lightning-charged bow that shows its worth in the storm.

design.eternalrealm.peak_snipers_horizon.ja: 峰の狙撃手が、地平の彼方まで射抜いた長弓。
design.eternalrealm.peak_snipers_horizon.en: The longbow the peak sniper used to strike beyond the horizon.

design.eternalrealm.hollowroot_blade.lor.ja: 終焉の森の朽ちた根から生まれた、毒を吸う剣。
design.eternalrealm.hollowroot_blade.lor.en: A poison-drinking sword born from the rotten roots of the forest of the end.

design.eternalrealm.oblivion_edge.lore.ja: 斬られた者は、斬られたことさえ忘れるという。
design.eternalrealm.oblivion_edge.lore.en: It is said those it cuts forget they were ever cut.

design.eternalrealm.last_dusk.lore.ja: 終焉より来るものが携えていた、最後の夕暮れの色。
design.eternalrealm.last_dusk.lore.en: Carried by the thing that came from the end: the color of the last dusk.

design.eternalrealm.nightmare_greatsword.ja: 終焉の騎士の悪夢から鍛え出された、黒い大剣。
design.eternalrealm.nightmare_greatsword.en: A black greatsword forged from the nightmares of the knights of the end.

design.eternalrealm.towerfall_greatsword.ja: 塔の外壁を砕いた石の大剣。崩れた階の重みを宿す。
design.eternalrealm.towerfall_greatsword.en: A stone greatsword that broke the tower's wall; it holds the weight of fallen floors.

design.eternalrealm.black_knights_requie.ja: 終焉の黒騎士が、斬り伏せた者を弔って鳴らす刃。
design.eternalrealm.black_knights_requie.en: The black knight of the end sounds this blade as a dirge for those it fells.

design.eternalrealm.shadowsilk_fangs.lor.ja: 影を織った絹のように、刃が闇に溶ける。
design.eternalrealm.shadowsilk_fangs.lor.en: The blades melt into darkness like silk woven from shadow.

design.eternalrealm.doomguard_shivs.lore.ja: 塔の衛士が、侵入者の喉を裂くために帯びた。
design.eternalrealm.doomguard_shivs.lore.en: Worn by the tower's guards to open the throats of intruders.

design.eternalrealm.voidwhisper_daggers..ja: 刃を抜くと、虚無の囁きが聞こえる。
design.eternalrealm.voidwhisper_daggers..en: Draw them and you hear the whispers of the void.

design.eternalrealm.corrupt_bark_spear.l.ja: 腐った樹皮を巻いた穂先が、毒を滲ませる。
design.eternalrealm.corrupt_bark_spear.l.en: Its head is wrapped in rotten bark that seeps poison.

design.eternalrealm.gatebreaker_halberd..ja: 塔の門を幾度も破ってきた、重い斧槍。
design.eternalrealm.gatebreaker_halberd..en: A heavy halberd that has broken the tower's gates many times.

design.eternalrealm.nihils_voidfang.lore.ja: 虚無を喰む竜の牙。突き刺したものの影まで喰らうという。
design.eternalrealm.nihils_voidfang.lore.en: The fang of the drake that gnaws the void; they say it devours even the shadow of what it pierces.

design.eternalrealm.cultist_bonestaff.lo.ja: 終焉を崇める信徒が、儀式に用いる髑髏の杖。
design.eternalrealm.cultist_bonestaff.lo.en: The skull staff worshippers of the end use in their rites.

design.eternalrealm.abyssal_lantern.lore.ja: 塔の深淵で灯され続けてきた、決して消えない光。
design.eternalrealm.abyssal_lantern.lore.en: A light kept burning in the tower's abyss that never goes out.

design.eternalrealm.xenos_ruinsceptre.lo.ja: 破滅の先触れが、世界の終わりを告げるために掲げた笏。
design.eternalrealm.xenos_ruinsceptre.lo.en: Raised by the herald of ruin to announce the end of the world.

design.eternalrealm.deadwood_bow.lore.ja: 枯れた森の木から削り出した、毒棘の弓。
design.eternalrealm.deadwood_bow.lore.en: A bow of poison thorns carved from the dead forest.

design.eternalrealm.end_howl_longbow.lor.ja: 放たれた矢は、終焉の獣の遠吠えのような音を立てる。
design.eternalrealm.end_howl_longbow.lor.en: Its arrows sound like the howl of the beasts of the end.

design.eternalrealm.oblivion_shard_bow.l.ja: 忘却の結晶を棘のように並べた、冷たい弓。
design.eternalrealm.oblivion_shard_bow.l.en: A cold bow lined with shards of oblivion like thorns.

design.eternalrealm.wheatstalk_sword.lor.ja: 麦畑の見回りに使われる、軽くて扱いやすい剣。
design.eternalrealm.wheatstalk_sword.lor.en: Light and easy to handle; used to patrol the wheat fields.

design.eternalrealm.millstone_blade.lore.ja: 水車小屋の石臼から削り出した、重い石の剣。
design.eternalrealm.millstone_blade.lore.en: A heavy stone sword ground from the mill's millstone.

design.eternalrealm.harvest_moon_sabre.l.ja: 豊穣の祭りの夜、満月の下で打たれた金色の曲刃。
design.eternalrealm.harvest_moon_sabre.l.en: A golden curved blade forged under the full moon on the night of the harvest festival.

design.eternalrealm.plowshare_greatsword.ja: 畑を耕した鋤の刃を、畑を守る大剣に打ち直した。
design.eternalrealm.plowshare_greatsword.en: A plow blade reforged into a greatsword that guards the fields.

design.eternalrealm.granary_gate_blade.l.ja: 穀倉の門の閂を剣にしたもの。長く、ずっしりと重い。
design.eternalrealm.granary_gate_blade.l.en: A granary gate's bar turned into a sword; long and heavy.

design.eternalrealm.brutus_horncleaver.l.ja: 暴れ牛ブルータスの角を、そのまま刃にした大剣。
design.eternalrealm.brutus_horncleaver.l.en: A greatsword made straight from the horn of Brutus the rampaging bull.

design.eternalrealm.twin_sickles.lore.ja: 麦刈りの鎌を二本、そのまま武器にした。
design.eternalrealm.twin_sickles.lore.en: Two harvest sickles taken up as weapons.

design.eternalrealm.strawman_needles.lor.ja: 呪いの藁人形に刺さっていた、毒の長針。
design.eternalrealm.strawman_needles.lor.en: Long poisoned needles that were stuck in a cursed straw doll.

design.eternalrealm.blight_harvest_scyth.ja: 実りを枯らす根の鎌。刈り取った命の数だけ錆びている。
design.eternalrealm.blight_harvest_scyth.en: Scythes of the root that withers the harvest, rusted by every life they reaped.

design.eternalrealm.pitchfork_spear.lore.ja: かかしの亡者が決して手放さない、二股の熊手。
design.eternalrealm.pitchfork_spear.lore.en: The two-pronged fork the scarecrow dead never let go of.

design.eternalrealm.golden_ear_lance.lor.ja: 黄金色の麦穂をかたどった、祭りのための槍。
design.eternalrealm.golden_ear_lance.lor.en: A festival lance shaped like a golden ear of wheat.

design.eternalrealm.harvest_boss_reaper..ja: 収穫泥棒の頭目が、畑ごと刈り取るために振るった。
design.eternalrealm.harvest_boss_reaper..en: Swung by the harvest thieves' boss to reap whole fields at once.

design.eternalrealm.scarecrow_post.lore.ja: 立てておくだけで鳥も獣も寄りつかない、不気味な杖。
design.eternalrealm.scarecrow_post.lore.en: An eerie staff that keeps birds and beasts away just by standing there.

design.eternalrealm.sunflower_staff.lore.ja: いつも太陽の方を向いている、明るい花の杖。
design.eternalrealm.sunflower_staff.lore.en: A bright flower staff that always turns toward the sun.

design.eternalrealm.stroms_strawcrown.lo.ja: 案山子の王が掲げる、燃える冠の杖。畑に近づく者を焼き払う。
design.eternalrealm.stroms_strawcrown.lo.en: The burning crowned staff the scarecrow king raises; it sets fire to all who come near the fields.

design.eternalrealm.crow_scaring_bow.lor.ja: 畑の鴉を追い払うための、黒い羽を飾った弓。
design.eternalrealm.crow_scaring_bow.lor.en: A bow decorated with black feathers, made to drive crows from the fields.

design.eternalrealm.cornsilk_bow.lore.ja: とうもろこしのひげを撚った弦は、驚くほど強い。
design.eternalrealm.cornsilk_bow.lore.en: Its string, twisted from corn silk, is surprisingly strong.

design.eternalrealm.bullhorn_recurve.lor.ja: 牛の角を曲げて作った、反りの強い弓。
design.eternalrealm.bullhorn_recurve.lor.en: A strongly curved bow bent from bull horn.

design.eternalrealm.reedcutter.lore.ja: 湖畔の葦を刈る細い刃。人も獣も同じように刈る。
design.eternalrealm.reedcutter.lore.en: A thin blade for cutting lakeside reeds; it cuts men and beasts the same.

design.eternalrealm.lake_scale_sword.lor.ja: 湖底の主ヌメルの鱗を重ねた刃。冷たい水の気をまとう。
design.eternalrealm.lake_scale_sword.lor.en: A blade of layered scales shed by Numel of the lakebed; it carries cold water.

design.eternalrealm.mirror_surface_blade.ja: 湖底の破壊獣が沈めていた、湖面のように澄んだ刃。
design.eternalrealm.mirror_surface_blade.en: Sunk by the beast of the lakebed; a blade as clear as the lake's surface.

design.eternalrealm.driftwood_greatsword.ja: 湖に流れ着いた大木から削った、素朴な大剣。
design.eternalrealm.driftwood_greatsword.en: A rough greatsword carved from a great tree washed onto the shore.

design.eternalrealm.marshking_greatsword.ja: 沼地の王が泥の中から引き抜いた、毒の滴る大剣。
design.eternalrealm.marshking_greatsword.en: Pulled from the mud by the king of the marsh; it drips poison.

design.eternalrealm.numels_greatfin.lore.ja: 湖底の主の背鰭を削り出した大剣。冷たい水の重さで斬る。
design.eternalrealm.numels_greatfin.lore.en: A greatsword carved from the dorsal fin of the lakebed's master; it cuts with the weight of cold water.

design.eternalrealm.minnow_knives.lore.ja: 小魚のように素早く、銀色に光る小刀。
design.eternalrealm.minnow_knives.lore.en: Quick as minnows and gleaming silver.

design.eternalrealm.gel_glass_daggers.lo.ja: 沼のゼリーを固めた、透き通る毒の刃。
design.eternalrealm.gel_glass_daggers.lo.en: Translucent poison blades of hardened marsh jelly.

design.eternalrealm.kingfisher_pair.lore.ja: 水面へ飛びこむ翡翠鳥のように、一瞬で獲物を捉える。
design.eternalrealm.kingfisher_pair.lore.en: Like a kingfisher diving into the water, they catch prey in an instant.

design.eternalrealm.rusted_harpoon.lore.ja: 錆びてなお鋭い銛。返しが傷口を広げる。
design.eternalrealm.rusted_harpoon.lore.en: Still sharp beneath the rust; its barbs widen the wound.

design.eternalrealm.pearl_tide_spear.lor.ja: 湖の水位が満ちるたび、穂先の真珠が冷たく光る。
design.eternalrealm.pearl_tide_spear.lor.en: The pearl on its head glows cold whenever the lake rises.

design.eternalrealm.drowned_fishers_gaff.ja: 沈んだ漁師が、今も湖から獲物を引き上げる鉤。
design.eternalrealm.drowned_fishers_gaff.en: The hook the drowned fisher still uses to haul prey from the lake.

design.eternalrealm.lotus_staff.lore.ja: 泥の中から咲く蓮のように、清らかな光を放つ。
design.eternalrealm.lotus_staff.lore.en: It shines pure like a lotus blooming from mud.

design.eternalrealm.lakebed_oracle.lore.ja: 湖底の真珠に映る未来を、巫女たちが読み取った。
design.eternalrealm.lakebed_oracle.lore.en: Priestesses read the future reflected in the lakebed pearl.

design.eternalrealm.melusines_mirror.lor.ja: 湖の魔女メリューが、覗く者の心を凍らせた水鏡。
design.eternalrealm.melusines_mirror.lor.en: The water mirror Melu the lake witch used to freeze the hearts of those who looked in.

design.eternalrealm.reed_bow.lore.ja: 束ねた葦を芯にした、湖畔の民の軽い弓。
design.eternalrealm.reed_bow.lore.en: The light bow of the lakeside folk, cored with bound reeds.

design.eternalrealm.dragonfly_bow.lore.ja: 蜻蛉の翅のように透き通った飾りが、雷を帯びる。
design.eternalrealm.dragonfly_bow.lore.en: Its dragonfly-wing ornaments are clear as glass and carry lightning.

design.eternalrealm.spirit_pearl_bow.lor.ja: 水の精霊が宿る真珠を、弓の両端に嵌めた。
design.eternalrealm.spirit_pearl_bow.lor.en: Pearls home to water spirits are set in both ends.

design.eternalrealm.deckhand_cutlass.lor.ja: 海賊の下っ端が腰に下げる、手に馴染む曲刀。
design.eternalrealm.deckhand_cutlass.lor.en: The handy curved sword pirate deckhands hang at their hips.

design.eternalrealm.doubloon_rapier.lore.ja: 鍔に金貨を嵌めた、伊達男の細剣。
design.eternalrealm.doubloon_rapier.lore.en: A dandy's rapier with a gold coin set in the guard.

design.eternalrealm.barbas_tidecleaver.l.ja: 隻眼の船長が、嵐の海ごと斬り裂いた片刃剣。
design.eternalrealm.barbas_tidecleaver.l.en: The single-edged blade the one-eyed captain used to cut through stormy seas.

design.eternalrealm.anchor_greatsword.lo.ja: 船の錨を打ち直した、とてつもなく重い大剣。
design.eternalrealm.anchor_greatsword.lo.en: A tremendously heavy greatsword reforged from a ship's anchor.

design.eternalrealm.stormsail_greatsword.ja: 嵐を受けた帆のように、振るえば風と雷が唸る。
design.eternalrealm.stormsail_greatsword.en: Like a sail catching a storm, it howls with wind and thunder when swung.

design.eternalrealm.ankaras_great_pincer.ja: 錨を喰らう大ガニの鋏。鋼の錨さえ挟み潰す。
design.eternalrealm.ankaras_great_pincer.en: The pincer of the crab that eats anchors; it crushes even a steel anchor.

design.eternalrealm.saltspray_daggers.lo.ja: 潮風に晒され続け、冷たい塩の結晶をまとう。
design.eternalrealm.saltspray_daggers.lo.en: Long exposed to the sea wind, they wear cold salt crystals.

design.eternalrealm.inkstorm_blades.lore.ja: 海魔の墨を流しこんだ刃。斬るたびに闇が散る。
design.eternalrealm.inkstorm_blades.lore.en: Blades poured with sea-monster ink; darkness scatters with every cut.

design.eternalrealm.dock_brawlers_knuckl.ja: 港の喧嘩屋が、拳ごと叩きつける刃付きの拳鍔。
design.eternalrealm.dock_brawlers_knuckl.en: Bladed knuckles the dock brawler slams in along with his fists.

design.eternalrealm.boarding_pike.lore.ja: 敵船に乗りこむときに使う、短く頑丈な槍。
design.eternalrealm.boarding_pike.lore.en: A short, sturdy pike for boarding enemy ships.

design.eternalrealm.windlass_harpoon.lor.ja: 船の巻き上げ機で引き戻す、銅の銛。
design.eternalrealm.windlass_harpoon.lor.en: A copper harpoon pulled back by the ship's windlass.

design.eternalrealm.maelstrom_trident.lo.ja: 嵐を呼ぶ呪術師が海を渦巻かせた、珊瑚の三叉。
design.eternalrealm.maelstrom_trident.lo.en: The coral trident the storm-calling sorcerer used to whirl the sea.

design.eternalrealm.buoy_lantern_staff.l.ja: 港の浮標灯を杖にしたもの。嵐の夜も消えない。
design.eternalrealm.buoy_lantern_staff.l.en: A harbour buoy light made into a staff; it does not go out on stormy nights.

design.eternalrealm.compass_rose_staff.l.ja: 羅針盤の星形を頂に戴く、航海士の杖。
design.eternalrealm.compass_rose_staff.l.en: A navigator's staff crowned with the star of a compass.

design.eternalrealm.kraken_ink_rod.lore.ja: 触腕のように曲がった杖の先で、墨の珠が揺れる。
design.eternalrealm.kraken_ink_rod.lore.en: An ink orb sways at the tip of a staff curled like a tentacle.

design.eternalrealm.gunwale_bow.lore.ja: 船べりから海賊を射るための、潮に強い弓。
design.eternalrealm.gunwale_bow.lore.en: A salt-proof bow for shooting pirates from the gunwale.

design.eternalrealm.seagull_bow.lore.ja: 港の海鳥のように白く、風を受けて軽く鳴る。
design.eternalrealm.seagull_bow.lore.en: White as harbour gulls; it hums lightly in the wind.

design.eternalrealm.trade_wind_longbow.l.ja: 遠い海を渡る風を弦に受け、矢を運ぶ。
design.eternalrealm.trade_wind_longbow.l.en: It carries its arrows on the winds that cross far seas.

design.eternalrealm.bandit_king_twinshad.ja: 地下都市の盗賊王が、影と入れ替わりながら振るった一対。
design.eternalrealm.bandit_king_twinshad.en: The pair the undercity's bandit king swung while trading places with his shadows.

design.eternalrealm.ancient_tree_heartst.ja: 古代樹の守護者の胸で脈打っていた、琥珀の心臓。
design.eternalrealm.ancient_tree_heartst.en: The amber heart that beat in the chest of the ancient tree's guardian.

design.eternalrealm.colossus_dunespear.l.ja: 砂塵の巨神が、砂嵐とともに突き出した大地の槍。
design.eternalrealm.colossus_dunespear.l.en: The earthen spear the sand colossus thrust out with the sandstorm.

design.eternalrealm.frozen_executioner_b.ja: 凍獄の処刑人が、罪人の数だけ振り下ろした氷の刃。
design.eternalrealm.frozen_executioner_b.en: The ice blade the executioner of the frozen prison brought down once for every prisoner.

design.eternalrealm.frozen_queen_sceptre.ja: 氷獄の女王が、城ごと時を凍らせた王笏。
design.eternalrealm.frozen_queen_sceptre.en: The sceptre with which the frozen queen froze time along with her castle.

design.eternalrealm.dragon_king_flamebra.ja: 灼炎の竜王の焔が、いまも燃え続ける王の剣。
design.eternalrealm.dragon_king_flamebra.en: A king's sword in which the scorching dragon king's flame still burns.

design.eternalrealm.machine_god_skybow.l.ja: 天空の機械神が、雷の矢で天を縫いとめた弓。
design.eternalrealm.machine_god_skybow.l.en: The bow with which the machine god of the sky stitched the heavens with lightning.

design.eternalrealm.gatekeeper_end_halbe.ja: 終焉の門番が、門の先へ通す者を選んだ斧槍。
design.eternalrealm.gatekeeper_end_halbe.en: The halberd with which the gatekeeper of the end chose who may pass the gate.

design.eternalrealm.king_of_end_greatswo.en: Black Sword of the King of the End

design.eternalrealm.king_of_end_greatswo.ja: 終焉の王の剣。黒い刃が雨のように降り注ぐ幻を見せる。
design.eternalrealm.king_of_end_greatswo.en: The sword of the king of the end; it shows visions of black blades falling like rain.

armor_set.eternalrealm.meadow_runner.lor.ja: 草原を一日中駆けても疲れない、風通しのよい旅装。
armor_set.eternalrealm.meadow_runner.lor.en: Airy travel gear you can run the meadows in all day.

armor_set.eternalrealm.homestead_guard.l.ja: 地下都市の脅威から村を守った、開拓団の古い鎧。
armor_set.eternalrealm.homestead_guard.l.en: Old armor of the settlers who defended the village from the undercity.

armor_set.eternalrealm.wildflower_vestme.ja: 草原を呑む影を鎮めた巫女の、花で飾られた法衣。
armor_set.eternalrealm.wildflower_vestme.en: The flowered robes of the priestess who calmed the shadow that swallowed the meadow.

armor_set.eternalrealm.moonleaf_robe.lor.ja: 月光を浴びた葉で染めた、森の魔術師の衣。
armor_set.eternalrealm.moonleaf_robe.lor.en: A forest mage's garb dyed with moonlit leaves.

armor_set.eternalrealm.silkshadow.lore.ja: 蜘蛛の糸で織られた白い装束。月の下では影すら映らない。
armor_set.eternalrealm.silkshadow.lore.en: White garb woven from spider silk; under the moon it casts no shadow.

armor_set.eternalrealm.heartwood_bulwark.ja: 月蝕の巨樹の樹皮を、鱗のように重ねた鎧。
armor_set.eternalrealm.heartwood_bulwark.en: Armor of bark from the eclipse tree, layered like scales.

armor_set.eternalrealm.ironvein_plate.lo.ja: 坑道の鉄で打たれた鎧。琥珀色の鉱脈が光る。
armor_set.eternalrealm.ironvein_plate.lo.en: Plate hammered from mine iron; amber veins glow in it.

armor_set.eternalrealm.ember_scholar.lor.ja: 砂塵の神殿で炎の古文書を読み解いた学士の衣。
armor_set.eternalrealm.ember_scholar.lor.en: Robes of the scholars who read the fire scrolls of the sand temple.

armor_set.eternalrealm.dune_stalker.lore.ja: 坑底の破壊獣を追った狩人の、砂に溶けこむ装束。
armor_set.eternalrealm.dune_stalker.lore.en: Garb that melts into the sand, worn by the hunters of the beast of the mine.

armor_set.eternalrealm.rivermist_garb.lo.ja: 霧の立つ川辺で身を隠すための、冷気を通さない装束。
armor_set.eternalrealm.rivermist_garb.lo.en: Cold-proof garb for hiding on misty riverbanks.

armor_set.eternalrealm.glacier_warden.lo.ja: 凍てつく地下牢の番人が着た、氷の鎧。
armor_set.eternalrealm.glacier_warden.lo.en: The ice armor worn by the wardens of the frozen dungeon.

armor_set.eternalrealm.holy_spring_vestm.ja: 堕ちる前の滝守がまとっていた、清らかな法衣。
armor_set.eternalrealm.holy_spring_vestm.en: The pure robes the keeper of the falls wore before the fall.

armor_set.eternalrealm.rune_sage.lore.ja: 遺跡の碑文をまとう賢者の衣。文字に雷が宿る。
armor_set.eternalrealm.rune_sage.lore.en: Robes of a sage clad in ruin inscriptions; lightning dwells in the letters.

armor_set.eternalrealm.cinder_dancer.lor.ja: 火山の祭りで炎の中を舞う踊り手の装束。
armor_set.eternalrealm.cinder_dancer.lor.en: Garb of the dancers who whirl through the flames at the volcano festival.

armor_set.eternalrealm.ruin_guardian_pla.ja: 遺跡を焦がす焔を封じてきた、守護者の石の鎧。
armor_set.eternalrealm.ruin_guardian_pla.en: The stone armor of the guardians who sealed the flame that scorched the ruins.

armor_set.eternalrealm.thunderpeak_armor.ja: 雷の落ちる峰で鍛えられ、文様に稲妻を宿す。
armor_set.eternalrealm.thunderpeak_armor.en: Forged on the peaks where lightning strikes; bolts live in its patterns.

armor_set.eternalrealm.cloudweaver.lore.ja: 天空の民が雲を紡いで織った、軽やかな法衣。
armor_set.eternalrealm.cloudweaver.lore.en: Light vestments the sky folk weave from spun cloud.

armor_set.eternalrealm.skystrider.lore.ja: 峰を砕く巨像と戦った戦士の、雷をまとう装束。
armor_set.eternalrealm.skystrider.lore.en: The lightning-clad garb of the warriors who fought the colossus that breaks the peaks.

armor_set.eternalrealm.voidstep.lore.ja: 足音を虚無に吸わせる、塔の暗殺者の装束。
armor_set.eternalrealm.voidstep.lore.en: The tower assassins' garb; the void swallows their footsteps.

armor_set.eternalrealm.endless_night_pla.ja: 終焉の塔の衛士長に与えられる、夜より黒い鎧。
armor_set.eternalrealm.endless_night_pla.en: Plate blacker than night, given to the captains of the tower guard.

armor_set.eternalrealm.oblivion_vestment.ja: 終焉より来るものに仕えた魔術師の、記憶を喰う衣。
armor_set.eternalrealm.oblivion_vestment.en: The memory-eating robes of mages who served the thing from the end.

armor_set.eternalrealm.farmstead_bulwark.ja: 錆びた農具を打ち直して作った、頼もしい鎧。
armor_set.eternalrealm.farmstead_bulwark.en: Dependable armor reforged from rusted farm tools.

armor_set.eternalrealm.scarecrow_garb.lo.ja: かかしの亡者から剥いだ、呪いの染みた麻袋の装束。
armor_set.eternalrealm.scarecrow_garb.lo.en: Sackcloth garb taken from the scarecrow dead, soaked with curses.

armor_set.eternalrealm.harvest_rite.lore.ja: 実りを枯らす根を祓う祭りで、神官がまとう衣。
armor_set.eternalrealm.harvest_rite.lore.en: Robes priests wear at the rite that drives off the root that withers the harvest.

armor_set.eternalrealm.lotus_vestment.lo.ja: 湖の巫女たちが、蓮の花びらを模して仕立てた法衣。
armor_set.eternalrealm.lotus_vestment.lo.en: Vestments the lake priestesses tailored after lotus petals.

armor_set.eternalrealm.lakescale_mail.lo.ja: 湖底の主ヌメルの鱗を綴り合わせた、冷たく軽い鎧。
armor_set.eternalrealm.lakescale_mail.lo.en: Cold, light mail laced from the scales of Numel of the lakebed.

armor_set.eternalrealm.reedwalker.lore.ja: 湖底の破壊獣の縄張りを渡るための、葦で編んだ装束。
armor_set.eternalrealm.reedwalker.lore.en: Reed-woven garb for crossing the territory of the beast of the lakebed.

armor_set.eternalrealm.privateer_garb.lo.ja: 港の私掠船乗りが好む、金ボタンの粋な装束。
armor_set.eternalrealm.privateer_garb.lo.en: The dashing gold-buttoned garb the harbour's privateers like.

armor_set.eternalrealm.tidecaller_robe.l.ja: 潮の満ち引きを操る魔術師がまとう、珊瑚飾りの衣。
armor_set.eternalrealm.tidecaller_robe.l.en: Coral-trimmed robes of the mages who command the tides.

armor_set.eternalrealm.anchorguard_plate.ja: 嵐を呼ぶ呪術師から港を守り抜いた衛兵の鎧。
armor_set.eternalrealm.anchorguard_plate.en: The plate of the guards who held the harbour against the storm-calling sorcerer.

art.eternalrealm.art_shadow_legion.desc.ja: 煙に紛れて分身し、六方向から斬り刻む。最後の一撃で出血させる。
art.eternalrealm.art_shadow_legion.desc.en: Vanish into smoke and cut from six sides with your shadow doubles; the last blow makes the foe bleed.

art.eternalrealm.art_thornroot_bloom.des.ja: 狙った場所に茨の根を咲かせる。中の敵を縛って傷つけ、味方を癒やす。
art.eternalrealm.art_thornroot_bloom.des.en: Thorn roots bloom where you aim: they bind and hurt foes inside and heal allies.

art.eternalrealm.art_sand_maelstrom.desc.ja: 三連の突きのあと、前方に砂の大渦を起こして敵を引きずりこむ。
art.eternalrealm.art_sand_maelstrom.desc.en: Three drilling thrusts, then a sand vortex ahead drags enemies in.

art.eternalrealm.art_doom_guillotine.des.ja: 印した場所に氷の刃を落とす。弱った敵ほど深く斬り、凍りつかせる。
art.eternalrealm.art_doom_guillotine.des.en: A blade of ice falls on the marked spot; it cuts the weakened deepest and freezes them.

art.eternalrealm.art_frozen_prison.desc.ja: 狙った場所の敵を氷に閉じこめ、しばらくして牢ごと砕く。
art.eternalrealm.art_frozen_prison.desc.en: Entomb the enemies at the target in ice, then shatter the prison.

art.eternalrealm.art_meteor_slash.desc.ja: 燃える斬撃を放ち、刃の先へ流星を降らせる。
art.eternalrealm.art_meteor_slash.desc.en: A burning slash, then meteors fall where the blade pointed.

art.eternalrealm.art_heavens_chain.desc.ja: 扇状に貫く矢を放ち、狙った場所へ雷を落とし続ける。
art.eternalrealm.art_heavens_chain.desc.en: Loose a fan of piercing arrows, then lightning keeps striking the target.

art.eternalrealm.art_gate_of_end.desc.ja: 前方に虚無の門を開いて敵を引きずりこみ、まとめて炸裂させる。
art.eternalrealm.art_gate_of_end.desc.en: Open a void gate ahead that drags enemies in, then bursts.

art.eternalrealm.art_black_sword_rain.de.ja: 周囲に黒剣の雨を降らせ、当たった敵を脆くする。自身の攻撃力も高まる。
art.eternalrealm.art_black_sword_rain.de.en: Black swords rain down around you and leave foes vulnerable; your attack rises.

skill_info.eternalrealm.effect.revive.en: Revives fallen allies within %s blocks (%s%% health)
